## Details

<a id="title_screen"></a>
### [`title_screen`](../../../../src/data/title_screen_text.asm#L6) `$66E8-$67E7`

*data*

Title screen, 40 x 25 screen codes of the text character set: MICRO FUN PRESENTS, the BOULDER DASH logo and the licence lines. The title copies bytes 0-767 to the screen at $0800 and bytes 744-999 to $0ee8 of the screen at $0c00.

- **Read by:** [`draw_title_screen`](../title/draw_title_screen.md#draw_title_screen)
